caption:
Anthropic's Opus 5 has set a new benchmark in AI performance, scoring 30.2% on the ARC-AGI-3. This score eclipses the previous record of 7.8% held by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol. The model's advanced reasoning capabilities have enabled it to solve five previously unsolved environments, with four solutions at or above human level. 680916
